messages:
Alicia Park: Quick sync — I'm worried current pipeline design favors flexibility (late enrichment + many joins) but causes instability and high cost for attribution. Can we talk slimming options?
Ben Chu: +1. We hit an incident last week where late-enrich OOMed and pushed ingest p99 to 2s. See incident thread.
Cheng Li: Can you paste the trace/log that blew up? My guess is cross-tenant join exploded cardinality.
Alicia Park: here's the snippet we got from the worker logs:
```json
{"trace_id":"abc123","phase":"late-enrich","mem":"18Gi","key_counts":1200000}
```
Marta Gómez: High-level tradeoff: strict schema gating at ingress reduces flexibility but keeps cost predictable. Proposal: introduce a 'compact' envelope mode for high-volume paths and keep 'enrichable' mode for low-volume only.
Ben Chu: compact mode semantics: drop optional attrs, preserve billing_key, tenant_id, trace_id, and minimal routing hints. Route detection can be config-driven.
Cheng Li: Migration concern: how do we avoid losing attribution for older clients? Need a backfill mapping + a soft-fallback lookup path for legacy envelopes.
Alicia Park: Proposal: add a stable header trace_meta.v1 that services write once. Runtime maps legacy keys -> v1 during a grace period (48h) then we flip.
Marta Gómez: Also add a sampling flag on the envelope so sampled traces can carry full enrichment bundle even in compact mode.
ingest-bot: Deploy scheduled: feature/compact-envelope -> staging at 2025-03-10 09:00 UTC :gear: 
Ben Chu: Operational idea: create an SLO/metric 'attribution_loss_rate' = traces_without_billing_key / total_traces. Alert if >0.1% over 1h.
Cheng Li: Implementation sketch: add an 'attr-normalize' stage before fanout. Keep it idempotent and O(1) per envelope (hash + lookup). Pseudocode:
```go
if envelope.Type == "compact" {
  billingKey = envelope.BillingKey
} else {
  billingKey = mapLegacy(envelope.Meta) // cheap lookup table
}
emit(attr_normalized{billingKey})
```
Marta Gómez: Ops plan: run in shadow mode for 2 weeks (emit metrics, no gating). Then flip for configured routes. Backfill mapping job to run concurrently.
Alicia Park: I'll write an RFC: "compact-envelope rollout + legacy-mapping" and include test matrix + rollback plan. Can @Ben Chu and @Cheng Li review? :thumbsup:
Ben Chu: lgtm — will skim tonight and leave comments.
Cheng Li: I'll prototype attr-normalize in a sandbox and share perf numbers by EOD.
ingest-bot: CI: compact-envelope unit/integration tests passed on branch feature/compact-envelope :white_check_mark:
Marta Gómez: Scheduling RFC review: Tues 10am PT. Invite incoming.
Alicia Park: Filing the RFC + meeting invite now, adding acceptance criteria (0.1% attribution loss, shadow metrics healthy). Thanks all.
